bio.text: Anne Brensley is a Republican who announced a write-in campaign for Secretary of the Commonwealth in July 2026 after not qualifying for the ballot as a candidate for lieutenant governor.
According to WBUR, she was elected to the Wayland Select Board in 2023 and works as CEO of DevCo North America.
WBUR reported that she graduated from Suffolk University School of Law in 2008, and that her campaign website says she was born in Honduras and adopted at a young age.

sources.title: Anne Brensley, a Republican member of the Wayland Select Board, runs for lieutenant governor
